categories.main_business_segments: Beijing Bohui Science & Technology Co., Ltd focuses on the audiovisual big data sector, providing intelligent audiovisual information technology products and services across three main areas: media security, smart education, and intelligent display control. Their offerings include media content safety monitoring and regulatory solutions, smart classroom and teaching solutions, and large-screen display and seat collaboration solutions.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages proprietary core technologies in audiovisual big data collection, analysis, and visualization. Key technical capabilities include edge collection technology for diverse broadcast signals, intelligent content analysis using AI and multimodal recognition, data visualization, audiovisual data security intelligence, and predictive analytics. Hardware products achieve over 90% localization, and software is fully domestically developed based on B/S architecture. Production is mainly outsourced assembly with in-house embedded software programming and testing.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Primary customers include television stations, broadcasting and telecom operators, government media regulatory agencies, educational institutions (notably universities and vocational colleges), and government defense units. The company serves media regulators, broadcasters, IPTV platforms, telecom operators, and educational entities across China, providing solutions for media content safety, smart campus infrastructure, and audiovisual command and control.
categories.geographic_coverage: Operations and sales are primarily concentrated in China, with significant presence in major regions including North China, Central China, South China, East China, Northeast China, Northwest China, and Southwest China. Key customers span national-level agencies and provincial broadcasters across 28 provinces, autonomous regions, and municipalities.
categories.supply_chain_position: Bohui Technology operates primarily in the midstream and downstream segments of the audiovisual information technology supply chain. It develops and integrates software and hardware solutions, providing end-to-end audiovisual data collection, analysis, and display systems. The company outsources hardware manufacturing and focuses on R&D, system integration, and after-sales services.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes AI integration, focusing on embedding artificial intelligence deeply into media security, smart education, and intelligent display control. It actively develops large AI models, multimodal content analysis algorithms, and AI-generated content recognition technologies. R&D emphasizes domestic substitution, AI safety, and innovation in audiovisual big data applications, with ongoing projects in AI-powered network live monitoring, smart classrooms, and digital twin technologies.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through product sales of proprietary software and hardware solutions, including audiovisual monitoring systems, smart education platforms, and display control products. Additional income comes from technical services such as system integration, maintenance, and customized solution development. Sales are conducted via direct contracts with end customers and through agents or system integrators.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Bohui Technology is positioned as a leading domestic provider in the audiovisual information technology industry, recognized for its strong technical capabilities and extensive customer base. It competes with other specialized audiovisual and AI technology firms serving media, education, and government sectors. The company holds a stable market share with broad coverage of national and provincial regulatory agencies and major educational institutions.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported revenues of approximately RMB 172.8 million, a 9.9% decrease from the previous year, with a net loss attributable to shareholders of RMB 38.47 million, showing an improvement over prior losses. Total assets stood at about RMB 726 million, with net assets of RMB 615 million. R&D investment accounted for over 31% of revenue, reflecting a strong commitment to innovation despite profitability challenges.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Bohui Technology emphasizes its deep technical expertise, proprietary AI-driven audiovisual big data technologies, and comprehensive solutions tailored to media security, education, and command display needs. Its products feature high reliability, accuracy, and integration of advanced AI models for content analysis and security monitoring. The company highlights its domestic technology leadership, extensive industry experience, and strong customer service network as key differentiators.
